title: Aureline M5 template publish attribution
description: Canonical per-domain descriptor for a template publish / export attribution — the typed record of exactly which template text a local-draft, publish-now, open-in-provider, or export flow will send, and how each field is accounted for. Names the object class, its review-pack association, the template version and pack digest the content is bound to, the result binding (field-provenance — whether each field is pack-authored, generated, user-edited, omitted, or redacted; template-version-and-digest — the version / digest carried through publish, export, and reopen; or destination-and-redaction — the destination, template source, and redaction state that must be shown before send), the field provenance class, and the destination / redaction state so a publish or export surface can never send template-driven review content without preserving the template version and pack digest and without first showing destination, template source, and redaction state, and so user edits and redactions stay visibly separate from pack-authored template content. Downstream the review detail, review-pack summary, AI review panel, provider handoff, support / export packets, and help / docs point at this schema instead of restating publish attribution by hand. Raw secret values and private endpoints never cross this boundary.
